title: Find the series
text: Replace u with $$x^2$$ in $$\ln\left(1+u\right)$$, whose series has terms $$\frac{{\left(-1\right)}^{n-1} u^n}{n}$$. This gives terms $$\frac{{\left(-1\right)}^{n-1} x^{2n}}{n}$$.

title: Use the ratio test
text: The ratio of consecutive terms approaches $$x^2$$, so the series converges when $$x^2<1$$. So $$R=1$$.
